description: Germany only. Special protection against dismissal under German law (Sonderkündigungsschutz): checks 11 grounds such as pregnancy, parental leave, care leave, works council, severe disability, data protection officer, apprentices and whistleblowers. Returns a traffic light, the authority whose consent is needed, the protected period and the steps before giving notice. Use it before any dismissal, also in small businesses. Germany only.

azubi.description: Is the person an apprentice whose probation period is over? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

beauftragte.description: Is the person an appointed officer for emission control, incidents, waste or water protection, or was removed from that role within the last 12 months? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

betriebsrat.description: Is the person a member of the works council, the youth representation or representative of severely disabled employees, or left such office within the last 12 months? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

betriebsrat_vorhanden.description: Is there a works council (Betriebsrat) in the business? Default nein. Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

dsb.description: Is the person your mandatory data protection officer, or was removed from that role within the last 12 months? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

elternzeit.description: Has the person requested parental leave (Elternzeit) or is on it, or works part-time while receiving parental allowance? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

hinweisgeber.description: Has the person recently reported a violation (whistleblowing), internally or to an external reporting channel? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

laenger_als_6_monate.description: Only for severe disability: has the employment lasted more than 6 months without interruption? Default ja. Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

mutterschutz.description: Is the person pregnant, gave birth up to 4 months ago, still in the protection period after birth, or had a miscarriage after the 12th week of pregnancy? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

pflege.description: Has the person announced or is taking short-term care leave, care leave or family care leave (Pflegezeit, Familienpflegezeit)? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

schwerbehindert.description: Is the person severely disabled (degree of disability 50 or more) or treated as equal (gleichgestellt)? Answer unklar if an application is pending or you do not know. Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

wahl.description: Is the person on the election board or a candidate, or did they invite to or prepare a works council election? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.

wehrdienst.description: Has the person received a call-up notice or is doing military service or a military exercise? Answer ja, nein or unklar; not answered counts as nein.
